create_robust_fit_pipeline: create a scikit-learn pipeline combining PolynomialFeatures with robust linear estimators for sine curve fitting
run_ols_linear_regression: run OLS linear regression on noisy sine data with polynomial feature transformation
run_ransac_regressor: run RANSACRegressor to fit robust polynomial model against strong y-direction outliers
run_theil_sen_regressor: run TheilSenRegressor to fit robust model against small X and y measurement errors
run_huber_regressor: run HuberRegressor to lessen outlier influence without completely filtering them
test_robust_estimators: test OLS, Theil-Sen, RANSAC, and HuberRegressor on corrupted sine data using mean squared error
